scope: Final frozen-source PDF/PPTX exports and structural validation; Office visual QA is recorded separately.
checks: Expected page count and exported order
PPTX ZIP CRC, relationships, native object and Notes counts
Resolved occurrence Notes match with Unicode and whitespace normalization
Fallback image bytes and pixel visibility
limitations: Font files are not embedded; Office rendering is checked separately.
Native chart layout is reported by the exporter and checked in Office separately.
Icons and one multi-point line use verified image fallbacks, preserving appearance without native object editability.
